dict.intro: ‏Configure and inspect the plugins installed in this deployment.

dict.bashTimeoutMsHint: ‏How long one command may run before it is terminated.
dict.bashMaxOutputBytesHint: ‏Output beyond this spills to a temporary file rather than being lost.
dict.agentLoopMaxParallelHint: ‏Upper bound on parallel-safe calls running at once within one step.

dict.webSearchMaxUsesHint: ‏How many times one request may search before it must answer.
